query: How to write a Band 7+ Task 1 overview without numbers?
rationale: This guidance is grounded in public IELTS descriptors: answer all parts; maintain a clear position; provide an overview in Task 1; select and compare key features with correct units/time; prefer 'invisible cohesion'.

evidence.title: IELTS Writing Task 1 — Overview Requirement
evidence.text:
- Provide a 1–2 sentence global overview without numbers.
- Capture main trends/extremes/stages, not details.

evidence.title: Time & Length Norms
evidence.text:
- Task 1: ~20 minutes, ≥150 words.
- Task 2: ~40 minutes, ≥250 words; no bullets/notes.

evidence.title: IELTS Writing Task 2 — Lexical Resource (LR)
evidence.text:
- Use precise, appropriate lexis and collocations.
- Paraphrase accurately without distorting meaning; avoid repetition.

summary_bullets: - [IELTS Writing Task 1 — Overview Requirement] - Provide a 1–2 sentence global overview without numbers.
- [IELTS Writing Task 2 — Lexical Resource (LR)] - Use precise, appropriate lexis and collocations.
